name: get_qqq_gex_retained_summary
description: Count locally retained GEX published/partial dates and observed inputs without reading full profiles. Counts are evidence inventory, not complete market coverage or payload-integrity certification.

name: rebuild_qqq_gex_history
description: Resume bounded imports of locally retained normalized observations through the original algorithm. Each input commits independently; failures persist and are retried only when requested. Never fills unavailable history.

limit.description: limit argument for rebuild_qqq_gex_history; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

retryFailed.description: retryFailed argument for rebuild_qqq_gex_history; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: get_qqq_gex_replay
description: Compute original causal directional replay from local imported history only. Range is bounded to 366 days; ranges above 32 days use original daily summaries; missing data/runtime is explicit and no remote source is consulted.

page.description: page argument for get_qqq_gex_replay; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

pageSize.description: pageSize argument for get_qqq_gex_replay; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: calculate_qqq_gex_local
description: Run the bundled original GEX algorithm on the previously captured local normalized input and atomically publish its local display resources. Uses the bundled pinned Node runtime; reports unavailable or invalid input rather than installing a runtime or inventing data.

name: get_qqq_gex_archive
description: Read the exact locally retained page archive: date discovery, snapshot metadata, lossless per-strike profile, 2-minute regular bars, separate extendedBars (premarket/after-hours), or original provider-body metadata (resource=providers, hash used by view providerRaw). No remote fallback or observation writes. Continuations require the first page revision; changed revisions require restarting. Missing history and incomplete IV remain explicit.

archiveState.description: published (default) or partial; partial raw observations never certify regular replay or complete history

date.description: Trading date YYYY-MM-DD; required except dates

capturedAt.description: Exact capturedAt from snapshot listing; required for profile

page.description: page argument for get_qqq_gex_archive; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

pageSize.description: pageSize argument for get_qqq_gex_archive; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

revision.description: First page revision; required for page > 1

priceBasis.description: bars/extendedBars only. Default valuation retains aligned model inputs; display reads separately retained observed stock prices, never used for GEX/PCS decisions.

name: get_qqq_gex_lifecycle
description: Read hash-verified locally recorded source PCS lifecycle observations for one trading date. Never computes or invents historical points; missing coverage stays explicit.

name: get_qqq_gex_live_decision
description: Evaluate the pinned source PCS daily/previous-close gate, timing and real-chain candidate from retained local routed inputs. Read-only, no remote fallback. Source delays, date alignment and stale/missing inputs remain explicit; never grants account/order permission.

name: get_qqq_gex_view
description: Read local QQQ GEX charts, indicators, analysis and source/state data in bounded base64 chunks, including workspace persisted filters/preferences, private-document pointer/focus/hover observations and last desktop capture/quote observation (freshness explicit): display/evidence (latest or 90-minute window), context (20 prior trading days), exposure manifest/one-hour profile window, or historical two-leg quote. No remote capture. Continuations require SHA256; changes restart. Decode and concatenate chunks before JSON/NDJSON parsing. Missing data stays explicit.

analysis.description: Original UI kernel; wallTouches.presentation is the qualified filtered UI result (legacy summary is raw/unfiltered); ATM IV/MaxPain cross-expiry curves use scope=all

hiddenLegends.description: hiddenLegends argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

discovery.description: discovery argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

policy.description: Day scenario contribution policy; default partial matches UI and reports excluded/missing contributions

viewportFrom.description: Price-reaction viewport start ISO-8601; requires viewportTo and plotWidth

viewportTo.description: Price-reaction viewport end ISO-8601, at most 25 hours after start

plotWidth.description: plotWidth argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

reactions.description: reactions argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

overlays.description: overlays argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

strikes.description: strikes argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

ivShockPp.description: ivShockPp argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

fees.description: fees argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

manualCredit.description: manualCredit argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

scope.description: Expiry scope; use all for UI ATM IV/MaxPain cross-expiry curves, selected for one-expiry history

from.description: ISO-8601 start; use exact manifest window for exposure

source.description: Exact exposure window version from manifest

at.description: Historical quote cutoff, analysis cursor, or fixed context response timestamp ISO-8601

shortStrike.description: shortStrike argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

longStrike.description: longStrike argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

dte.description: dte argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

offset.description: offset argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

length.description: length argument for get_qqq_gex_view; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

providerHash.description: Exact retained provider body hash from get_qqq_gex_archive resource=providers; providerRaw only, never a file path

sha256.description: First chunk hash; required for continuation

name: capture_qqq_gex_input
description: Capture one coherent QQQ option snapshot from existing routed providers and complete 2-minute price buckets to local normalized input. Explicit network/write; preserves delay, gaps and provider snapshot times. Does not calculate or claim historical completeness.
